rationale: C16 plausibly supplied the child’s concrete drafting framework. Both proclamations use the same distinctive two-stage machinery: the Interior Secretary adopts regulations under the Migratory Bird Treaty Act after Administrative Procedure Act notice and procedure; the regulation is reproduced within the proclamation; the President then finds that approval will effectuate the Act and formally approves and proclaims it under section 3. The child adapts that established structure from general migratory-bird amendments to a geographically defined closed area. C25 is a weaker geographic-wildlife analogue with a lengthy boundary description and hunting prohibition, while C12 shares only the more general land-reservation form.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Whereas the Acting Secretary of the Interior has adopted, after notice and public procedure pursuant to section 4 of the Administrative Procedure Act ... and has submitted to me for approval the following regulation relating to migratory birds
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Whereas the Secretary of the Interior has adopted, after notice and public procedure pursuant to section 4 of the Administrative Procedure Act ... and has submitted to me for approval the following amendments of the regulations relating to migratory birds and game mammals
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim recital establishing Interior adoption, APA procedure, and presidential submission.

shared_material.child_excerpt: By virtue of and pursuant to the Migratory Bird Treaty Act ... and Reorganization Plan II ... and in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Act ... having due regard to the zones of temperature and to the distribution, abundance, economic value, breeding habits, and times and lines of migratory flight
shared_material.parent_excerpt: By virtue of and pursuant to the Migratory Bird Treaty Act ... and Reorganization Plan II ... and in accordance with the provisions of the Administrative Procedure Act ... having due regard to the zones of temperature and to the distribution, abundance, economic value, breeding habits, and times and lines of migratory flight
shared_material.explanation: Long, specialized statutory and factual formula is materially identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: And Whereas upon consideration it appears that the foregoing regulation will tend to effectuate the purposes of the aforesaid migratory Bird Treaty Act ... under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 3 ... do hereby approve and proclaim the foregoing regulation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: And Whereas upon consideration it appears that approval of the foregoing amendments will effectuate the purposes of the aforesaid migratory Bird Treaty Act ... under and by virtue of the authority vested in me by section 3 ... do hereby approve and proclaim the foregoing amendments.
shared_material.explanation: The presidential approval clause follows the same operative sequence and language, changing only the regulatory object.
